description: Show visual analytics with charts when the user asks for salon analytics or charts; not a salon-setup follow-up. Read aggregate BeautyOS analytics for one linked salon over 7, 30, 90 or 180 days. Native catalog and Altegio return appointments, booked service value (not collected payments), clients and utilization with daily charts. Other connected providers support dialogue analytics for 7 or 30 days only. Respects current insights.read permission; never returns client names or conversations. Reports cache freshness and data limitations. Does not generate a paid AI report.
name: beautyos_get_analytics
title: Salon analytics and charts
